hotel_name: Limewood Stay Premier | Golf Course Sector 42

positive_snippets: Excellent stay! The rooms were clean and comfortable. Staff was polite and helpful. Service was quick and food was delicious. Highly recommended.

Excellent location, just a short walk from HUDA Metro Station. Rooms are modern and well built with clean attached washrooms. Loved the breakfast buffet and the food at the in-house restaurant — tasty and hygienic!
